text_block_list.name: Observing Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for allowing me to observe.
After watching her videos, I became curious about her unique training plan.
choice_data_list: Almost everything I know, I learned from Master.

text_block_list.name: Observing Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That is all the more reason
why I wanted to check for myself.

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I... thank you so much, too!
Even though I'm an outsider...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You want to become a Tracen Academy student one day, right?
Then that means you're not an outsider at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps due to the impact of Gran Alegria's video, more trainers and Umamusume had been requesting to observe her lately.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: It's particularly hot today, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, I'm just not really
feeling hyped up for this...
choice_data_list: Then how about we just go for a light swim today?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"That would be great.
About how much should I swim?"
choice_data_list: Just enough to work up a pleasant tiredness, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: (Mmm~, 3 miles feels so good~...)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(I'll take it easy today...
and give it my all starting tomorrow♪)

text_block_list.name: Observing Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Pushing yourself isn't the only way to train,
but isn't this a bit too lax...?

text_block_list.name: Observing Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It's about time we started leaning down
for the Sprinters Stakes, right?
choice_data_list: It's not like I only cram in training right before a race, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that I designed the training plan
with her being able to run comfortably as the top priority.

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Still... will that really make me stronger?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —I'll show you that in the race!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Haa...!
That dash just now was great, wasn't it!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think that was the best one of the whole training camp!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! Trainer,
I want to do more distance runs!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'm fully tuned into 95 miles right now!
choice_data_list: Sure, go run as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Observing Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...I see,
so you have her run hard when she's in the mood to secure enough training volume...!"

text_block_list.name: Observing Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for letting me observe.
It really gave me a lot to think about regarding coaching approaches.

text_block_list.name: Observing Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"What is best for an Umamusume—
I will keep that close to heart as I guide them."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wah...! You really felt it, didn't you?
The greatness of Master's style...!"
choice_data_list: Yeah. Getting the message across to the officials is huge!
Yeah. Getting the word out to the officials is huge!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If the awareness of Umamusume and their guiding Trainers
shifts toward showing them greater respect—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Eventually, putting Umamusume first might become the standard across the entire Umamusume world!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it,
about those recent comments..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable, the comments talking about
conquering all three divisions are increasing!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's excitedly talking about why conquering three distance categories is so amazing
and discussing the history of those who challenged it!
choice_data_list: Huh? Those posts are from regular fans, right?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Both long-time race fans
and casual fans alike!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For us, wanting to spread my mentor's teachings,
it's certainly something to be grateful for, but..."
choice_data_list: Somehow, it feels like this is going to turn into a huge swell...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: For now, let's ride this wave!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: We've added an extra 1.2 miles of in-depth racing talk, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with summer camp showing signs of growth behind us,
we finally head into a season of autumn challenges.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First is the Sprinters Stakes.
And then—onward to conquering three divisions.
